findings.finding: TPA3221DDVR is the pad-UP (top heat slug) DDV package; footprint has no EP and the board has no heatsink, no heatsink mounting provision and no keep-out. Without a heatsink Tj = 45 + 3.5 W x ~50 C/W = ~220 C at 1/8 power into 4 ohm (OTE 145-165 C, latched); even 8 ohm 1/8 power reaches ~120 C (OTW 115 C min). Max chip loss under OTW without heatsink ~1.4 W (~2 x 4 W into 4 ohm).
findings.evidence: SLASEE9C rev C: sec 5 'heat slug located on the top side', table 5-1 PowerPad 'placed on top side', DDV0044D note 5; 6.4 RthetaJA 44.8 C/W JEDEC 2s2p no heatsink; OTW/OTE 6.5; fig 6-9 system loss 4 ohm ~6.5 W @25 W out (30 V). core.kicad_pcb: U15 footprint 44 pads, no EP; only holes H1-H4. hwde check_thermal (2026-10-29) warns only 'found 9 vias, want >=36' and passes the rise using constraints.json theta 8.0 C/W; vias cannot fix a top-slug part (board path floor = RthetaJB 14.9 C/W; 36 vias -> ~185 C, still OTE).
findings.fix: Fit a heatsink per TPA3221: base 19x12 mm (free volume), fins >=25 mm tall to lid under lid vents, RthetaSA <=20 C/W natural convection; interface 0.2 mm >=3 W/mK pad or <=0.1 mm >=1.5 W/mK thermal adhesive with mechanical hold-down (NOT plain adhesive tape). Board: reserve 19x12 mm keep-out for parts >1.0 mm under the base; add two GND-plated 1.5 mm clip slots at dx = +/-9.5-10 mm on U15/U16 long axis (move C207/C209 ~2 mm out) so a wire clip clamps and grounds the heatsink. Plus firmware governor (THERMAL-2). Contingency: pad-down pin-compatible TPA3220DDW (C2879306, stock 0 on 2026-10-28) on an EP land with via array. Also add GND stitching vias next to GND pin groups 5-7, 18-20, 25-26, 33-34, 41-42 (zero cost, parallel board path ~16 -> ~15 C/W with heatsink). Ultra U16: identical heatsink + slots, enclosure vents >=2500 mm2.
findings.margin: With spec heatsink: total ~16-18 C/W -> Tj 101-108 C at 1/8 P 4 ohm (7-14 K under OTW min; 117-126 C at upper loss estimate), 69-72 C at 1/8 P 8 ohm. With 19x12x25 on adhesive tape: 118 C centre / 139 C upper -> insufficient.

findings.finding: Continuous full power cannot be held by any passive heatsink in the available volume: chip ~19-22 W (4 ohm, supply-limited to ~113-154 W out) -> OTE in ~9 s with a clamped 19x12x25 heatsink (immediately with adhesive tape); 8 ohm full power (~9 W) -> OTE in ~30 s. Needs a firmware power governor.
findings.evidence: SLASEE9C fig 6-9 (26 W loss at 150 W out, 4 ohm); heatsink ~6.7 J/K; J-HS drop 22 W x 3.2 C/W = 70 K.
findings.fix: Firmware: ISENSE 60 s average <= 30 W in (1.05 A at 28 V) per TPA3221 (Ultra total <= 55 W, 2.0 A), 5 s average <= 70 W (2.5 A); OTW_CLIP low steadily >200 ms -> -3 dB every 2 s; FAULT -> mute, 1 s, toggle RESET, max 3 retries/10 min. Contingency: NTC 10k B3435 0603 (LCSC C2889048) within 3 mm of U15 GND pins 18-20, 10k pull-up to +3V3A into a free ESP32 ADC1 pin; board >70 C -> -3 dB/10 s, >85 C mute.
findings.margin: Sustainable chip loss with spec heatsink ~4 W (Tj 110 C at 45 C air).

findings.finding: TPA3118D2 passes at 1/8 power (Tj 94 C, 106 C upper, at 45 C air) but continuous full power trips its latched 150 C OTP: chip ~9 W into 4 ohm (~300 C steady), ~4.2 W into 8 ohm (163 C). The Lite has no current sense, no OTW pin, no temperature sensor: only FAULTZ after the fact.
findings.evidence: SLOS708G fig 14/16 (P1% ~38 W/ch at 20 V, eta 82-88 %), 6.6 thermal trip 150+ C, protection table 'Over Temperature ... Latched'; thetaJA 28 C/W estimate (TI 22 C/W on 2-layer EVM SLOU342A).
findings.fix: Firmware DSP RMS governor: 30 s RMS per channel <= 13 W at 4 ohm (<= 20 W at 8 ohm), i.e. -4.6 dB below 1 % full scale at 4 ohm; FAULTZ low -> mute, SDZ low >=100 ms, retry. Contingency: NTC 10k B3435 0603 LCSC C2889048 within 3 mm of U8 GND pins 13-15, 10k pull-up from +3V3A to a free ESP32 ADC1 pin; board >100 C -> -3 dB/10 s, >120 C mute.
findings.margin: 1/8 P 4 ohm: 56 K (44 K upper) to 150 C; max sustainable chip loss 3.2 W for Tj 135 C.

findings.finding: EP via array is 16 x 0.3 mm (4x4, 0.85 mm pitch), about half of TI's EVM (~32); in-pad vias are open (solder wicking/voids).
findings.evidence: lite-main.kicad_pcb U8 pad 33: 3.81x3.71 mm, 16 drilled pads 0.3/0.61 mm zone_connect solid; B.Cu GND 94 % within 10 mm; 16 vias ~13 C/W barrel resistance.
findings.fix: Add 8-12 more 0.3 mm GND vias in F.Cu GND around the EP between GND pins and at the package ends; order tented (bottom) via-in-pad.
findings.margin: -2 to -3 C/W, -4 to -5 K at 1/8 P.

findings.finding: Core PVDD bulk is only general-purpose 470 uF/50 V Rubycon PX (600 mA@120 Hz, x1.20 at >=10 kHz = 0.72 A); no polymer or extra ceramic bulk near the amp. Ripple ~0.55 A per cap at 1/8 P 4 ohm (76 %), ~1.25 A at full power (174 %, +20 K self-heating).
findings.evidence: Rubycon PX DS ripple multiplier table; tan d 0.10 -> ESR ~0.28 ohm@120 Hz; ripple ~Iout,rms x 0.5 per channel; per-chip ceramics 2 x (1 uF + 100 nF).
findings.fix: Add 2 x 10 uF/50 V X7R 1210 per TPA3221 at PVDD pins 29-31 and 36-38 (e.g. Samsung CL32B106KBJNNNE, LCSC number to verify), or change C5/C6/C311 to a low-impedance 50 V series (>=1.5 A at 100 kHz, e.g. Rubycon ZLH 470 uF 10x20, LCSC to verify), same footprint.
findings.margin: Life at 59 C: ~48,000 h (5.5 years of loud playing).

findings.finding: Lite box: the board fills the box (0.6 mm wall gap), so floor vents feed only the 5 mm under-board space; floor-to-lid flow ~0.03 W/K. Box air ~47-52 C at 1/8 P (25-30 C room), 57-62 C at governed max, i.e. above the brief's 35-40 C assumption.
findings.evidence: enclosure/lite.py GAP 0.6, vents 8x(2x26) floor + lid; box 106x96x46.8 = 0.0393 m2, U ~3.5-4 W/m2K; heat 1.9/3.5/5.1 W idle/1/8P/governed.
findings.fix: Enclosure only: widen GAP to >=3 mm on left/right walls (540 mm2 riser) or add rear-high/front-low wall slots; keep PETG/ASA (never PLA).
findings.margin: PETG Tg ~80 C: 18 K at governed max; PLA (55-60 C): ~0 K -> do not use.

findings.finding: Core Q1 AO4485 drain has no F.Cu PVDD copper (0 mm2 within 8 mm); heat and up to 5 A go through 4 vias into the 0.5 oz In2.Cu plane. Tj ~98 C at 5 A (0.48 W, 23 mohm max at 125 C).
findings.evidence: core.kicad_pcb copper measurement; AOS AO4485 DS RDS(on) 19/23 mohm at TJ 125 C, RthetaJA 75 C/W steady on 1 in2.
findings.fix: Add >=100 mm2 F.Cu PVDD pour on pins 5-8 and 4-6 more vias to In2.
findings.margin: 52 K to 150 C (-> ~64 K with fix).

findings.finding: CH340C (Lite U6, core U8) is rated -20 to +70 C ambient; Lite box air reaches 52 C at 1/8 P and 62 C governed in a 30 C room.
findings.evidence: WCH CH340 datasheet operating-temperature table; section 6.
findings.fix: Accept on Lite; if the core enclosure exceeds 60 C air, swap to CH343P (-40..85 C, board change).
findings.margin: 15 K at 1/8 P, 5 K at governed max (Lite).

findings.finding: core/kicad/constraints.json gives U15 theta_datasheet 8.0 C/W and 3.0 W; no source supports 8 C/W junction-to-ambient (datasheet: 44.8 no heatsink; 5.5 only to a heatsink held at 85 C). The verify gate passes the rise on that number while warning about via count, which cannot help a top-slug part.
findings.evidence: check_thermal run 2026-10-29: U15 rise 24 K (theta 8.0), warning 9 vias want >=36.
findings.fix: Set U15/U16 theta to 44.8 (or ~16 once the 1.5 heatsink exists) and power_w 3.5 (4.5 worst); add U16 for Ultra.

findings.finding: In AD mode (HEAD tied to GND) the output inductors see 1.17 A p-p ripple at idle (28 V, 10 uH, 600 kHz); unspecified core loss of ~0.2-0.4 W each puts ~1-1.5 W of 24/7 idle heat in the box, more than the TPA3221's 0.45 W.
findings.evidence: dI = PVDD*D(1-D)/(L f); SLASEE9C fig 6-16 idle 11 mA AD vs 8 mA HEAD at 28 V; PSPMAA0805 DS has no core-loss data.
findings.fix: Option to run HEAD mode: HEAD via 0R to AVDD / 0R to GND (one DNP); firmware puts amp in RESET after 10 min without a source.
findings.margin: Inductor dT at full power 21 K DCR + core loss, ~85 C part temp vs 125 C.
